in_sanskrit.name: Risu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Joy, Rain, Rice
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Risu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Risu is derived from the Sanskrit and Hindi language. It is believed to mean 'Joy' or 'Rain'. In Hinduism, the name Risu is also associated with the joy and happiness that comes from the harvesting of rice. It is a rare and beautiful name that is perfect for a child born during the rainy season or for one whose family is involved in agriculture.
